archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Developer Tool / Code Editor Precision)

typography.font_family_sans: Geist Variable, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

rules.labels: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-medium text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./: Three-pane IDE workspace — collapsible repo file tree left, syntax code viewer & function walker center, context-aware AI chat with evidence sidebar right
entry_surfaces./explorer: Full-canvas React Flow interactive code graph with mode switcher (Call Graph / Execution Flow), function inspector drawer, dual-node diff comparator, and blast-radius impact simulation bar
entry_surfaces./learn: Mastery hub & Quiz studio — topic / repo quiz selector with difficulty pills, active single-question quiz terminal with syntax snippets and instant pedagogical feedback, score telemetry & historical breakdown
entry_surfaces./login: Branded split auth terminal — CodeAtlas neural code intelligence showcase left, dark glass credentials portal right

visual_enhancers.editor_chrome: 1px solid #1E293B border, matte deep dark titlebar with macOS-inspired status dots, breadcrumb bar, active tab with glowing top border #3B82F6
visual_enhancers.graph_nodes: Custom React Flow node with dark border, node-type badges (controller, service, util, db), call-count pill, execution order badge, high-contrast SVG connection lines with animated dashed strokes for active execution paths
visual_enhancers.scrim_and_overlays: Modal backdrop backdrop-blur-md bg-black/60; drawer overlay with subtle right-to-left slide-in shadow
visual_enhancers.syntax_viewer: Prism-react-renderer with VSCode-dark / Night-Owl inspired custom theme, interactive line highlighting, active walkthrough indicator badge with step jumping controls

layouts_and_grids.app_shell: flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#0B0F17] text-slate-200
layouts_and_grids.persistent_sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-between bg-[#080C14] border-r border-slate-800/80 p-3 select-none
layouts_and_grids.file_tree_pane: w-64 border-r border-slate-800/80 bg-[#0A0F18] flex flex-col transition-all duration-200
layouts_and_grids.code_viewer_pane: flex-1 flex flex-col bg-[#070B12] overflow-hidden min-w-[360px]
layouts_and_grids.evidence_and_chat_pane: w-96 border-l border-slate-800/80 bg-[#0D131F] flex flex-col
layouts_and_grids.explorer_page: flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#070B12] relative overflow-hidden
layouts_and_grids.quiz_page: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-6

workspace_page.mode_selector: Beginner (high-level visual explanations & analogy), Student (conceptual breakdowns with computer science foundations), Expert (low-level runtime complexity, edge cases, AST breakdown)
workspace_page.repo_upload: Support ZIP file upload, local folder upload, or GitHub repository URL indexing. Step-by-step indexing progress bar: Fetching AST -> Parsing Symbols -> Generating Embedding Index -> Building Call Graphs -> Ready.
workspace_page.github_guide_modal: Accessible from upload modal with full visual walkthrough on generating GitHub personal access tokens or finding public repo URLs.
workspace_page.code_viewer: Line numbers, syntax highlighting via prism-react-renderer, breadcrumb trail (repo > folder > file.ts), file AI summary banner at top.
workspace_page.selected_code_follow_up: Selecting lines of code exposes a floating contextual chip: 'Ask AI about selection' which prefills the AI prompt with line ranges.
workspace_page.function_walkthrough: Interactive widget with Prev / Next step buttons that highlight corresponding line ranges in the code viewer, step title, and explanation.
workspace_page.alternative_implementations: AI-generated alternative implementations clearly labelled with a high-visibility badge: 'AI GENERATED - NOT FROM REPO' with trade-off comparison (Performance vs Readability vs Memory).
workspace_page.git_history_diff: Side-by-side or unified diff viewer showing commit changes for the active function across recent git revisions.

code_explorer_page.graph_modes: Toggle between Call/Dependency Graph (hierarchical dependencies) and Execution Flowchart (step-by-step logic branching with condition diamonds & action nodes).
code_explorer_page.node_interactions: Clicking a node opens the right-side Node Details Drawer showing exported signatures, callers, callees, complexity rating, and quick jump to code.
code_explorer_page.compare_functions: Modal allowing user to pick any two functions in the repo and inspect side-by-side signature, cyclomatic complexity, parameter contracts, and call trees.
code_explorer_page.impact_simulation: Simulate removing or deprecating a node. The graph highlights affected downstream nodes in warning red/orange, calculates blast radius score, and presents a persistent top banner: 'Impact Simulation Active: 4 dependent components broken' with [Undo] and [Reset Graph] buttons.

learning_dashboard.quiz_modes: General CS topics (Algorithms, React Architecture, Python Async, Git Internals) and Repository-Specific quizzes generated from the active indexed repo.
learning_dashboard.quiz_config: Difficulty selector (Easy, Medium, Hard), Question Count selector (3, 5, 10).
learning_dashboard.quiz_runner: One question at a time with animated progress bar, syntax-highlighted code question snippets, multiple choice options with keyboard shortcuts (1-4 or A-D).
learning_dashboard.instant_feedback: After submission, immediately presents correctness, deep pedagogical explanation, exact code line references, and 'Why other options are wrong'.
learning_dashboard.results_screen: Score percentage, grade badge, radar breakdown of Strengths vs Weaknesses, question review list, and [Retake Quiz] / [Review Code in Workspace] actions.
learning_dashboard.history_view: Table of completed quizzes with date, repo, topic, score, difficulty, and [Review] button.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 6 -> 0, duration: 0.18s ease-out)
motion_and_interactions.tabs_and_toggles: LayoutId sliding pill for active mode and graph mode selectors
motion_and_interactions.code_step_highlight: Smooth background color flash transition (#38BDF825 to #38BDF815) when stepping through walkthrough
motion_and_interactions.data_testid_convention: All action elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, quiz choices, code lines, graph nodes, upload triggers) MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g., data-testid='upload-repo-btn', data-testid='mode-selector-expert', data-testid='quiz-option-2', data-testid='simulate-impact-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required visualization & parsing libraries in frontend: `yarn add @xyflow/react prism-react-renderer canvas-confetti @types/canvas-confetti` (for React Flow and code syntax rendering).
Ensure the HTML root has `class='dark'` so all dark mode styles and tokens apply seamlessly.

Implement rich mock/seeded repositories (e.g. 'CodeAtlas Engine (TypeScript/FastAPI)', 'FastAPI Microservice', 'E-commerce React Store') so all features (file tree, code viewer, call graphs, quizzes) work immediately out of the box with realistic syntax-highlighted code.
Provide interactive mock indexing progress when users upload files or submit a GitHub URL.
Ensure React Flow nodes and edges are styled cleanly with dark theme nodes, crisp borders, and informative node headers.
Ensure every interactive element has a unique `data-testid` attribute for robust automated verification.
Include toast feedback via Sonner for actions like copying code snippets, resetting graph simulation, finishing quizzes, or saving settings.
